The whole week in nine steps. Each step names the page it happens on.

  1. Plan the menu Menu

    Build next week in Building Next (or plan it in Plan (Quick Build) and push). Set the Sunday and Wednesday drop dates — the week label fills itself. Check every dish shows ✓ in the Ready column.

  2. Open ordering Orders

    Open for orders on the ordering line. Deadlines sets each drop's cut-off.

  3. Orders arrive Orders

    Portal orders arrive confirmed and paid (Stripe). Phone/manual orders: + Add Order, then tap the pay pill to mark Paid or Comped. Anything needing attention shows in the summary line.

  4. Shop Purchasing & Stock

    Work the shopping list; tick lines off and Receive stock as it arrives. Show detail adds yield and cost columns.

  5. Cook Production

    Prep Day for prep lists, Cook Board while cooking — mark each component complete (temp + weight). Print station sheets for the kitchen.

  6. Pack Packing & Delivery → Packing

    Box Board: pick a cooked component, tick it into each box (or Mark all in). Watch for red Allergen check tags. Labels: enter the use-by date → Download unique labels → print on the thermal printer.

  7. Deliver Packing & Delivery → Route sheet

    Print the route sheet or work it on your phone; mark each drop delivered.

  8. Close the week Menu

    Advance Week after the Wednesday drop: archives this week and promotes next week to current.

  9. Weekly admin Finance · Customers

    Finance: P&L and trends, cost stack, labour. Customers: codes & referral partners, Merge duplicates, marketing-consent export.

Margins: food cost ≤35% · gross margin (food + packaging) ≥60% · net margin 10–20%.

⏭ Advance Week — pre-flight check

Connect Firebase Sync
One-time setup · Free · Works across all your devices
1
Go to console.firebase.google.com and sign in with your Google account. Click Add project, give it a name (e.g. 29-performance), disable Google Analytics (not needed), then click Create project.
2
In the left sidebar click Build → Realtime Database. Click Create Database, choose a location (e.g. europe-west1), then select Start in test mode and click Enable.
3
Go to Project Settings (gear icon, top left). Scroll to Your apps, click the </> Web icon. Register the app (any nickname), then copy the firebaseConfig object shown.
Paste your firebaseConfig object here
